newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares recoup losses, focus on Dow.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares recoup losses, focus on Dow.

text.p: Austrian shares closed steady on Monday, recouping earlier losses triggered by a plunge on Wall Street and traders said they were surprised Vienna managed to decouple itself from weaker international leads.
Traders said the focus would remain on how U.S. shares fare but expect the ATX index .ATX to tread water ahead of Friday's expiry of April futures and options contracts.
"America is currently very nervous -- I don't think we can hold onto present levels if the Dow continues to skid lower," said one.
Barring further falls on Wall Street, the ATX should be able to stabilise around 1,160. But further Dow losses could hammer the ATX down to 1,130 points, traders said.
Strong support for the ATX is seen at 1,150 points after it closed today at 1,164.40, up 0.45 points or 0.04 percent. It earlier fell to 1,149.14 points.
Traders said "good money" came into the market at 1,150 points, especially in VA Tech, EVN and VA Stahl.
Of the ATX's 21 constituents, 11 advanced, nine fell and one was unchanged.
The day's best performing stock was VA Stahl, up 2.33 percent at 465.70 ATS, while Flughafen led decliners, losing 2.56 percent at 502 ATS.
Regional utility EVN gained 1.3 percent to 1,599 ATS ahead of half-year results due for release on Tuesday.
The all-share Vienna bourse index lost 0.08 points, or 0.02 percent to 443.7 points.
The April ATX future added on eight points to 1,163.0 on turnover of 3,299 lots. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 256
